parks.name: parks
parks.query: SELECT p.id, p.type, p.name[1] AS name, p.names['en'][1] AS name_en, a."addr:city" AS city, a."addr:state" AS state, p.geometry FROM read_parquet('https://data.openstreetmap.us/layercake/parks.parquet') AS p LEFT JOIN read_parquet('https://data.openstreetmap.us/layercake/addresses.parquet') AS a ON p.type = a.type AND p.id = a.id WHERE p.leisure = 'park' AND (p.name[1] IS NOT NULL OR p.names['en'][1] IS NOT NULL) AND p.geometry IS NOT NULL AND p.bbox.xmax >= ? AND p.bbox.xmin <= ? AND p.bbox.ymax >= ? AND p.bbox.ymin <= ?

benches.name: benches
benches.query: SELECT id, amenity, name[1] AS name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS backrest, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS capacity, geometry FROM read_parquet('https://data.openstreetmap.us/layercake/pois.parquet') AS pois WHERE amenity = 'bench' AND geometry IS NOT NULL AND pois.bbox.xmax >= ? AND pois.bbox.xmin <= ? AND pois.bbox.ymax >= ? AND pois.bbox.ymin <= ?
